provider: NASA CCMC SEP Model Validation Challenge
product: Standard Input Parameters / GOES Proton Measurements
observation_method: CCMC values derived from GOES observations using the OpSEP validation workflow
transcription: Rows transcribed from the official >10 MeV/10 pfu and >100 MeV/1 pfu tables; N/A threshold crossings are preserved as non-crossings.
notes: This is the nine-event SHINE/ISWAT pilot, not the full 15–30 event/non-event EV01 campaign requested by the implementation plan. The current CLEAR benchmark should be used to expand the cohort when archived locally.
